_comment: Static last-resort fallback for trading_day.py when TWSE's live holiday-calendar endpoints are both unreachable (e.g. cloud IP block). Refresh once a year, usually in Q4 when TWSE publishes next year's schedule: fetch https://www.twse.com.tw/rwd/zh/holidaySchedule/holidaySchedule?response=json&queryYear=<ROC year>, drop rows whose Name/Description contains 開始交易 or 最後交易 (informational, still a trading day), keep every row containing 放假/補假/休市/無交易.
